arxiv-2106-10731.title: Neighborhood Contrastive Learning for Novel Class Discovery
arxiv-2106-10731.creator: Zhun Zhong 1, Enrico Fini 1∗, Subhankar Roy 1,3, Zhiming Luo 2, Elisa Ricci 1,3, Nicu Sebe 1 1 University of Trento 2 Xiamen University 3 Fondazione Bruno Kessler
arxiv-2106-10731.description: Abstract In this paper, we address Novel Class Discovery (NCD), the task of unveiling new classes in a set of unlabeled samples given a labeled dataset with known classes. We exploit the peculiarities of NCD to build a new framework, named Neighborhood Contrastive Learning (NCL), to learn discriminative representations that are important to clustering performance. Our contribution is twofold.

arxiv-2203-03737.title: Battery Cloud with Advanced Algorithms
arxiv-2203-03737.creator: Xiaojun Li, David Jauernig, Mengzhu Gao, Trevor Jones
arxiv-2203-03737.description: Abstract Energy storage battery plays a key role in modern interconnected energy networks. Recent development of Internet of Things (IoT) has enabled traditional battery management system to evolve into Battery Cloud. A Battery Cloud or cloud battery management system leverages the cloud computational power and data storage to improve battery safety, performance, and economy.

arxiv-2205-12580.title: On-Demand Redundancy Grouping: Selectable Soft-Error Tolerance for a Multicore Cluster Thanks: We acknowledge support by the EU H2020 Fractal project funded by ECSEL-JU grant agreement #877056.
arxiv-2205-12580.creator: Michael Rogenmoser 1 , Nils Wistoff 1 , Pirmin Vogel 2 , Frank Gürkaynak 1 , Luca Benini 1 3
arxiv-2205-12580.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michael Rogenmoser 1 , Nils Wistoff 1 , Pirmin Vogel 2 , Frank Gürkaynak 1 , Luca Benini 1 3. With the shrinking of technology nodes and the use of parallel processor clusters in hostile and critical environments, such as space, run-time faults caused by radiation are a serious cross-cutting concern, also impacting architectural design. This paper introduces an architectural approach to run-time configurable soft-error tolerance at the core level, augmenting a six-core open-source RISC-V cluster with a novel On-Demand Redundancy Grouping (ODRG) scheme.

arxiv-2207-06910.title: GWFAST : a Fisher information matrix Python code for third–generation gravitational–wave detectors
arxiv-2207-06910.creator: Francesco Iacovelli, Michele Mancarella, Stefano Foffa, Michele Maggiore
arxiv-2207-06910.description: Abstract We introduce GWFAST 1 1 1 https://github.com/CosmoStatGW/gwfast , a Fisher information matrix Python code that allows easy and efficient estimation of signal–to–noise ratios and parameter measurement errors for large catalogs of resolved sources observed by networks of gravitational–wave detectors.

arxiv-2303-05965.title: Scalable and Efficient Functional Map Computations on Dense Meshes Volume: 42 Issue: 2
arxiv-2303-05965.creator: Robin Magnet 1 and Maks Ovsjanikov 1 1 LIX, Ecole Polytechnique, IP Paris
arxiv-2303-05965.description: Abstract We propose a new scalable version of the functional map pipeline that allows to efficiently compute correspondences between potentially very dense meshes. Unlike existing approaches that process dense meshes by relying on ad-hoc mesh simplification, we establish an integrated end-to-end pipeline with theoretical approximation analysis.

arxiv-2305-09901.title: On the Difficulty of Intersection Checking with Polynomial Zonotopes
arxiv-2305-09901.creator: Yushen Huang, Ertai Luo, Stanley Bak, Yifan Sun
arxiv-2305-09901.description: Abstract Polynomial zonotopes, a non-convex set representation, have a wide range of applications from real-time motion planning and control in robotics, to reachability analysis of nonlinear systems and safety shielding in reinforcement learning. Despite this widespread use, a frequently overlooked difficulty associated with polynomial zonotopes is intersection checking.

pmc-10558102.title: Experiencia en la vacunación frente a la covid-19 en personas con antecedentes de alergia
pmc-10558102.creator: Juan Antonio García Vicente, Cristina Vedia Urgell, Roser Vallès Fernández, Crisitna Morgado Ramos, Esther Moral Roldán, Soraya Marchal Torralbo, Magda Lladó Blanch, Anna Marchal Torralbo, Thatiana Vértiz Guidotti, Josep Sorribes López
pmc-10558102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). RESUMENFundamentos:Una consulta habitual desde el inicio de la campaña de vacunación frente a la COVID-19 fue la relacionada con personas que tienen antecedentes de alergia a fármacos u otras vacunas. pmc-10578720.title: HBV suppresses macrophage immune responses by impairing the TCA cycle through the induction of CS/PDHC hyperacetylation
pmc-10578720.creator: Jiaxin Bei, Ye Chen, Qianbing Zhang, Xiaobin Wang, Liteng Lin, Jingjun Huang, Wensou Huang, Mingyue Cai, Weiguo Cai, Yongjian Guo, Kangshun Zhu
pmc-10578720.description: Background:It is now understood that HBV can induce innate and adaptive immune response disorders by affecting immunosuppressive macrophages, resulting in chronic HBV infection. However, the underlying mechanism is not fully understood. Dysregulated protein acetylation can reportedly influence the differentiation and functions of innate immune cells by coordinating metabolic signaling.

pmc-10749731.title: Three cases of suspected pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation
pmc-10749731.creator: Shiori Morikawa, Nobuaki Fukushima, Tomoya Arakawa, Tomoki Fujii, Shuto Negishi, Yuma Kawamura, Miyo Goto, Kazutaka Ozeki, Akio Kohno
pmc-10749731.description: This article reports the clinical course and imaging findings of three cases of suspected pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis (PPFE) after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT). All patients complained of dyspnea more than 5 years after HCT, had progressive restrictive deficits on respiratory function tests, and presented with pneumothorax, pleural thickening, or exacerbation of consolidation in the upper lobe of the lung.

pmc-11357409.title: Miamiensis avidus, a Novel Scuticociliate Pathogen Isolated and Identified from Cultured Large Yellow Croaker (Larimichthys crocea)
pmc-11357409.creator: Nengfeng Lin, Ying Pan, Zifeng Zhan, Binfu Xu, Hui Gong, Hong Zeng
pmc-11357409.description: Scuticociliates are recognized as the causative agents of mass mortalities in certain cultured marine fishes, resulting in enormous economic losses. This study aimed to investigate a fatal infection caused by scuticociliates in farmed large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea) in Fujian province, China. Microscopic examinations of focal organs, including the brain, eyes, gills, and skin, revealed the presence of parasites.

pmc-11599654.title: WS6 and 5-iodotubercidin small molecules and growth factors; TGF, HGF, and EGF synergistically enhance proliferation of β-like human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs)
pmc-11599654.creator: Saeedeh Akhavan, Mohammad Hossein Sanati, Shiva Irani, Zahra-Soheila Soheili, Ayyoob Arpanaei
pmc-11599654.description: ObjectivesIt has been shown that growth factors and small molecules play an essential role in the proliferation of β cells and insulin production. In this study, we investigated the effects of small molecules (WS6 and 5-iodotubercidin) and growth factors (TGFβ, HGF, and EGF) on the proliferation of β-like human ipSCs.

pmc-11610164.title: HTAD: a human-in-the-loop framework for supervised chromatin domain detection
pmc-11610164.creator: Wei Shen, Ping Zhang, Yiwei Jiang, Hailin Tao, Zhike Zi, Li Li
pmc-11610164.description: Topologically associating domains (TADs) are essential units of genome architecture, influencing transcriptional regulation and diseases. Despite numerous methods proposed for TAD identification, it remains challenging due to complex background and nested TAD structures. We introduce HTAD, a human-in-the-loop TAD caller that combines machine learning with human supervision to achieve high accuracy.

pmc-11689913.title: VIRTUAL IMPLEMENTATION OF MOBILITY PROGRAMS IN MEDICALLY COMPLEX POPULATIONS
pmc-11689913.creator: Alexander Garbin, Jennifer Stevens-Lapsley
pmc-11689913.description: Utilization of virtual platforms (e.g., Zoom, Teams, VA Video Connect) has rapidly expanded in both clinical and research settings since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. Within research, the use of virtual platforms affords numerous advantages including access to a broader geographical range of older adults, lack of dependency on transportation, and ability to monitor fidelity remotely.

pmc-12581692.title: Dual SMAD inhibition as a versatile platform in human pluripotent stem cell–based regenerative medicine and disease modeling
pmc-12581692.creator: Lesly Puspita, Magdalena Deline, Jae-won Shim
pmc-12581692.description: Dual SMAD inhibition is a robust and widely adopted protocol for directing human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) toward neuronal lineages by blocking transforming growth factor–beta and bone morphogenetic protein pathways. Suppressing transforming growth factor–beta and bone morphogenetic protein signaling enables efficient and reproducible induction of neuroectoderm, serving as the foundation for generating diverse brain region–specific neuronal subtypes.

pmc-12821936.title: Insomnia severity and its association with gaming behavior and perceived health in autistic adults
pmc-12821936.creator: Sydney Bouder, Lia K McNulty, Daehyoung Lee
pmc-12821936.description: BackgroundInsomnia is a prevalent and growing health concern among autistic adults, profoundly impacting their well-being. Empirical studies suggest that autistic adults tend to spend extensive time playing online or video games, which may contribute to sleep disturbances and low health perceptions in this population.

pmc-12826810.title: An Editor-in-Chief’s farewell
pmc-12826810.creator: Marcel F D’Eon
pmc-12826810.description: e chapter. In three previous editorials and a Canadiana, I have documented the tremendous growth and progress of the CMEJ1,2,3,4 Briefly, we expanded the CMEJ production from two issues a year up to six and have been doing so since 2020. Since 2021 we have had over 900 citations per year while our views and downloads have been climbing steeply.

pmc-13483205.title: Privacy-aware distributed intelligence with tokenized trust for low-latency task offloading in 6G vehicular edge networks
pmc-13483205.creator: Mohammad Alsaffar, Eman Abouelkheir, Wedad M Alawad, MAJED S ALSAYFI, Laila Nassef, Osama S Younes, Qaisar Abbas, Malik Bader Alazzam
pmc-13483205.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The ultra-dense vehicle scenarios envisioned in 6G put high requirements on ultra-low latency, secure cooperation, and efficient task offloading decisions. Existing systems usually optimize latency or energy independently but ignore joint privacy problems and long-term trust sustainability. In this work, a distributed intelligence architecture based on the combination of federated learning (FL) and blockchain based trust management for vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) edge computing is proposed.

pmc-13547970.title: OsASA2 Loss‐of‐Function Confers Broad‐Spectrum Disease Resistance and Triggers Cell Death by Regulating Anthranilate Synthase Activity in Rice
pmc-13547970.creator: Mingliang Guo, Shuyu Jiang, Ying Li, Zhiwei Chen, Shengping Li, Ziqiang Chen, Yuqing Niu, Mo Wang, Songbiao Chen, Dagang Tian
pmc-13547970.description: Lesion mimic mutants are valuable for studying plant cell death and defence mechanisms. Here, we identify a rice lesion mimic mutant, osasa2‐1, which exhibits spontaneous cell death and enhanced disease resistance. The mutant displays white spots on leaves that develop into large brown lesions. Histological analysis reveals increased cell death and H2O2 accumulation.

uslaw-usc-t15-s3805.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 64 (Methane Transportation Research, Development, And Demonstration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary, acting through appropriate agencies and contractors, shall initiate and provide for the conduct of research and development in areas relating to methane-fueled vehicles, including but not limited to— (1) flammability and combustibility of methane under conditions likely to develop.
